digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 plan review chunk and agent pool
propositions: With a cold cache, Pass-1 submits all chunks and agent futures into the pool concurrently, causing each of the first ~6 calls to independently perform a full cache-write for the identical plan system prefix (~7.9N effective tokens vs. ideal 2.15N).
The warm-then-fan-out pattern reduces redundant prefix writes by serializing the first chunk to completion to establish a warm cache, then submitting remaining chunks to the pool in parallel.
The warm gate activates when estimated shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and chunk/agent count >= 2; otherwise, or on warm-call exception, the pool fan-out runs unchanged.
Per-call cache instrumentation verifies the warm path incurs exactly one prefix cache-write and N-1 cache-reads for N total calls.
